text: Atlas is operated by the Platform Reliability team. The service handles authentication traffic.
Atlas Analytics is operated by the Developer Productivity team. The service produces internal reporting dashboards.
Platform Reliability maintains the Borealis storage system for production customer profile data.
Platform Reliability maintains the Aurora storage system for legacy reporting workloads.
For the production Borealis service, full backups run every Sunday. Incremental backups run every six hours.
For Borealis staging, incremental backups run every four hours to speed up recovery testing.
Aurora performs incremental backups every twelve hours for legacy reporting data.
Atlas deployment snapshots are created once per day for rollback support.
Developer Productivity maintains the Cirrus worker platform and build tooling.
